cards.example_en: Wear thick gloves to protect your hands from thorns.
cards.example_zh: 戴上厚手套，保护双手不被刺扎伤。
cards.explain_zh: 常用protect sb/sth from或against，表示免受伤害。

cards.example_en: Water is a precious natural resource.
cards.example_zh: 在博茨瓦纳，水是宝贵的自然资源。
cards.explain_zh: 资源总称常用复数resources；动词意为提供资源。
cards.source: Word Atlas; existing QuizMario bilingual correction

cards.example_en: We grew tiny crystals in our science class today.
cards.example_zh: 今天的科学课上，我们培育了微小的晶体。
cards.explain_zh: 泛指科学通常不可数；指具体学科可用a science。

cards.example_en: The vet checked our rabbit for signs of disease.
cards.example_zh: 兽医检查了我们的兔子，看是否有患病迹象。
cards.explain_zh: 重音在第二音节；泛指疾病可不加冠词。

cards.example_en: Access to clean drinking water can significantly reduce the spread of infectious diseases in vulnerable communities.
cards.example_zh: 获得清洁饮用水可以显著减少传染病在脆弱社区中的传播。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: She lost her balance while stepping off the bus.
cards.example_zh: 她下公交车时失去了平衡。
cards.explain_zh: 兼顾两者用balance A with B；均衡饮食用balanced。

cards.example_en: The storm caused serious damage to our garden shed.
cards.example_zh: 暴风雨严重损坏了我们花园里的棚屋。
cards.explain_zh: 损害用不可数damage；damages指法律赔偿金。

cards.example_en: These fresh vegetables form the basis of our soup.
cards.example_zh: 这些新鲜蔬菜是我们这锅汤的主要食材。
cards.explain_zh: 复数为bases；on a daily basis意为每天。

cards.example_en: These fresh vegetables form the basis of our soup.
cards.example_zh: 这些新鲜蔬菜是我们这锅汤的主要食材。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The author answered questions about her new adventure novel.
cards.example_zh: 这位作者回答了有关她新出版的冒险小说的问题。
cards.explain_zh: “……的作者”用the author of；也可作动词。

cards.example_en: This course teaches basic cooking skills to complete beginners.
cards.example_zh: 这门课程向零基础学员教授基本烹饪技能。
cards.explain_zh: 名词“基础知识”用复数 the basics。

cards.example_en: Local governments can encourage cycling by providing safer routes and secure bicycle parking near workplaces.
cards.example_zh: 地方政府可以通过提供更安全的路线和工作场所附近的安全自行车停车设施来鼓励骑行。
cards.explain_zh: 用encourage sb to do sth表示鼓励某人做某事。

cards.example_en: She tied her hair back before making lunch.
cards.example_zh: 她做午饭前把头发扎了起来。
cards.explain_zh: 整体头发不可数；一根头发用a hair。

cards.example_en: The male duck has a shiny green head.
cards.example_zh: 这只公鸭有一个亮闪闪的绿色脑袋。
cards.explain_zh: male可作形容词或名词；日常指男人通常用man。

cards.example_en: Can you show me how to operate this printer?
cards.example_zh: 你能教我怎么操作这台打印机吗？
cards.explain_zh: 操作机器直接接宾语；给某人做手术用operate on。

cards.example_en: His diary may reflect how he felt during exams.
cards.example_zh: 他的日记也许反映了他考试期间的心情。

cards.example_en: I get some exercise by walking to the shops.
cards.example_zh: 我步行去商店，顺便锻炼一下。
cards.explain_zh: 泛指运动时不可数；一项练习或一套动作中的动作可数。

cards.example_en: Regular exercise can improve mental health and reduce the risk of several common chronic diseases.
cards.example_zh: 经常运动能够改善心理健康，并降低几种常见慢性病的患病风险。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: This little torch is useful when the power fails.
cards.example_zh: 停电时，这个小手电筒很有用。
cards.explain_zh: 首音是辅音/j/，所以说a useful tool，不用an。

cards.example_en: We found a quiet restaurant beside the river.
cards.example_zh: 我们在河边找到了一家安静的餐馆。
cards.explain_zh: restaurant指用餐场所；hotel主要指住宿的酒店。

cards.example_en: My weekend job gives me a small extra income.
cards.example_zh: 我的周末兼职给我带来一小笔额外收入。
cards.explain_zh: income范围比salary广，也包括租金、投资收益。

cards.example_en: Please keep your personal property safe while you swim.
cards.example_zh: 游泳时，请妥善保管个人财物。
cards.explain_zh: 财产义不可数；房产和性质义可数。

cards.example_en: The previous tenant left some plants on the balcony.
cards.example_zh: 上一位租客在阳台上留下了几盆植物。
cards.explain_zh: previous是形容词；表示“以前”用副词previously。

cards.example_en: Previous studies suggest that regular physical activity can improve concentration and academic performance among school children.
cards.example_zh: 先前的研究表明，经常运动能提高学龄儿童的专注力和学习成绩。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The hallway was too dark to find my shoes.
cards.example_zh: 走廊太暗了，我找不到自己的鞋。
cards.explain_zh: dark既指光线暗，也指颜色深；黑暗常用the dark。

cards.example_en: Imagine living in a little house beside the sea.
cards.example_zh: 想象一下住在海边一栋小房子里的情景。
cards.explain_zh: imagine后接动名词，不接to do。

cards.example_en: The printed photo looks okay after we fixed the light.
cards.example_zh: 我们调好光线后，打印出来的照片看起来还行。

cards.example_en: Companies can earn public trust by reporting their environmental impact honestly and taking responsibility for their mistakes.
cards.example_zh: 企业可以通过如实报告环境影响并为自身错误负责来赢得公众信任。
cards.explain_zh: earn强调劳动或表现所得；win多指比赛获胜。

cards.example_en: Their daughter made pancakes for the whole family.
cards.example_zh: 他们的女儿给全家人做了薄煎饼。
cards.explain_zh: daughter-in-law是儿媳，不是继女。

cards.example_en: A parcel arrived in the post this morning.
cards.example_zh: 今天早上寄来了一个包裹。
cards.explain_zh: 邮寄义中，英式常用post，美式常用mail。

cards.example_en: My grandfather reads the newspaper while eating breakfast.
cards.example_zh: 我爷爷一边吃早饭一边看报纸。
cards.explain_zh: 一份报纸用a newspaper；作包装材料时可不可数。

cards.example_en: Can you define this word without using a dictionary?
cards.example_zh: 你能不用词典解释这个词的含义吗？
cards.explain_zh: define A as B表示“将A定义为B”。

cards.example_en: Governments should clearly define their environmental objectives before introducing policies that affect businesses and local communities.
cards.example_zh: 政府在推行影响企业和当地社区的政策前，应明确界定其环境目标。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We reached the same conclusion after checking the receipts.
cards.example_zh: 核对收据后，我们得出了相同的结论。
cards.explain_zh: “得出结论”用reach或draw a conclusion，不用make。

cards.example_en: The kitchen clock stopped while we were making lunch.
cards.example_zh: 我们做午饭时，厨房的时钟停了。
cards.explain_zh: clock通常指钟；戴在手腕上的表叫watch。

cards.example_en: Everybody is waiting outside for the doors to open.
cards.example_zh: 所有人都在外面等着开门。
cards.explain_zh: 作主语时谓语用单数：Everybody is ready。

cards.example_en: We usually visit the farmers' market at the weekend.
cards.example_zh: 我们通常在周末逛农贸市场。
cards.explain_zh: 英式常说 at the weekend，美式常用 on。

cards.example_en: We usually visit the farmers' market at the weekend.
cards.example_zh: 我们通常在周末逛农贸市场。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Our choir will perform at the community centre tonight.
cards.example_zh: 我们的合唱团今晚将在社区中心演出。
cards.explain_zh: 既可指表演，也可接task、duty表示执行。

cards.example_en: We hired a professional photographer for our wedding.
cards.example_zh: 我们为婚礼聘请了一位专业摄影师。
cards.explain_zh: 与amateur对比强调职业；形容态度时强调专业得体。

cards.example_en: Continuous professional development helps teachers adapt their methods to changing student needs and new educational technologies.
cards.example_zh: 持续的专业发展帮助教师调整教学方法，以适应学生需求的变化和新的教育技术。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: That red umbrella is mine.
cards.example_zh: 那把红伞是我的。

cards.example_en: We had a lively debate about keeping pets indoors.
cards.example_zh: 我们就把宠物养在室内的问题展开了热烈讨论。
cards.explain_zh: 动词可直接接议题；debate whether to表示权衡。

cards.example_en: My grandmother has an excellent memory for faces.
cards.example_zh: 我奶奶特别善于记住别人的长相。
cards.explain_zh: 记忆力通常不可数；一段段回忆用memories。

cards.example_en: She wore a green jacket to match her shoes.
cards.example_zh: 她穿了一件绿色夹克来搭配鞋子。
cards.explain_zh: 除颜色外，green常表示环保；形容人还可指缺乏经验。

cards.example_en: The whole bus sang one song until we reached camp.
cards.example_zh: 整辆车上的人唱着同一首歌，直到我们到达营地。

cards.example_en: A shiny object was lying beneath the sofa.
cards.example_zh: 沙发下面有个闪闪发亮的东西。
cards.explain_zh: 名词重音在前，动词在后；object to后接名词或动名词。

cards.example_en: Regular walks help me maintain a healthy weight.
cards.example_zh: 经常散步帮助我保持健康的体重。
cards.explain_zh: maintain后直接接宾语；表示坚持声称时可接that从句。

cards.example_en: We bought our new fridge on credit last month.
cards.example_zh: 我们上个月赊购了一台新冰箱。
cards.explain_zh: on credit表示赊购；学分义可数，常用复数。

cards.example_en: She slipped the silver ring onto her finger.
cards.example_zh: 她把那枚银戒指戴在了手指上。
cards.explain_zh: 响铃、打电话的过去式为rang，过去分词为rung。

word.example_en: Careful land management can protect biodiversity.
word.example_zh: 谨慎的土地管理能够保护生物多样性。

word.example_en: The country needs a plan for managing its natural resources.
word.example_zh: 该国需要制定管理自然资源的计划。

word.example_en: The lesson distinguishes renewable resources from non-renewable resources.
word.example_zh: 这节课区分可再生资源与不可再生资源。

word.example_en: We need more evidence before we draw a conclusion.
word.example_zh: 得出结论之前，我们需要更多证据。
